summary: Enhance your skills with Enterprise Search and Knowledge Retrieval Tools Training. Master effective strategies for efficient information access and management.
lede: Enterprise search and knowledge retrieval help teams make organizational information easier to find and reuse. Designed for professionals who shape or rely on search tools, the course covers mapping content sources and user needs, structuring information with metadata and tags, improving search relevance, and managing permissions and governance to support everyday knowledge retrieval.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who influence or depend on enterprise search and knowledge retrieval tools.
audience: Knowledge management and information management professionals
Customer support and service leaders using knowledge
modules: Principles of Enterprise Search and Knowledge Retrieval
Mapping Content, Users, and Search Journeys
Applying Enterprise Search to Real Business Scenarios
Tools, Platforms, and AI Powered Search
Security, Permissions, and Governance in Search
Communicating and Defending the Value of Search
prerequisites: Basic understanding of information systems and digital tools. Familiarity with organizational processes and workflows is beneficial.
